standard_prerequisites: the approximation lemma of the same chapter (lemma-approximate-by-etale-over-complement): a rig-etale morphism W to X_{/T} from a Noetherian affine formal algebraic space is realized as the completion of a finite type morphism etale over the complement
the More on Morphisms lemma checking etale-ness on infinitesimal neighbourhoods (more-morphisms-lemma-check-smoothness-on-infinitesimal-nbhds)
core_obligations: For T a closed subset of a Noetherian affine scheme X and g : W to X_{/T} rig-etale from a Noetherian affine formal algebraic space, there exists an affine scheme X' with a finite type morphism f : X' to X, etale over X \ T, and an isomorphism X'_{/f^{-1}T} = W compatible with f_{/T} and g.
Moreover, if W to X_{/T} is etale then X' to X is etale.
The proof restates the existence from the approximation lemma and derives the etale refinement from the infinitesimal neighbourhoods criterion.
proof_roadmap: Read off the existence of X' and f from the approximation lemma.
Derive the etale refinement via the check-on-infinitesimal-neighbourhoods lemma.
difficulty_reason: H2: a two-citation algebraization statement assembling existence from the approximation lemma and the etale refinement from the infinitesimal criterion.
